fields.field: Clinical phenotypes reported in affected individuals with Spastic ataxia 8 (NKX6-2), including exact wording from papers and standardized HPO terms if identifiable
Frequencies for each reported phenotype as exact numerator and denominator per cohort (not percentage alone), attached to resolvable PMID or DOI citations

Most discriminating clinical findings present in most affected individuals but uncommon in commonly confused overlapping disorders, including the specific names of those differential disorders and confidence level of the distinction
Clinical findings systematically assessed and found absent in affected individuals, whose presence would argue against the diagnosis
Phenotypic variations or genotype-phenotype/demographic correlations based on variant type, variant position, patient age, or sex
Conflicting or contradictory findings explicitly reported between different papers
